name: Camera

pages.text: Load film through the attachments menu, expose frames, then remove the roll for developing.

pages.title: Attachments
pages.text: Craft a Camera through JEI. Sneak-use it or right-click it in the inventory to open attachments. Insert film into its slot; lens, flash and filter have separate places.

pages.title: Taking pictures
pages.text: Use the camera for its viewfinder and shutter through native controls. Watch the remaining frames. Identical film items may contain different photos; retain the actual roll.

pages.title: From frame to paper
pages.text: Remove the exposed roll through attachments. $(l:handbook/items/exposure/black_and_white_film)Developing$(/l) produces developed film, while the $(l:handbook/items/exposure/lightroom)Lightroom$(/l) prints a paper photograph.

jem_summary: Load film through the attachments menu, expose frames, then remove the roll for developing.
